Subject: Request: AWS Marketplace procurement questionnaire — metering & security sections

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement at NovaCloud asked us to collect a completed copy of your AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace questionnaire focusing on (1) metering & billing integration, (2) tenant isolation and data handling, and (3) security evidence (SOC2/ISO/SCA). They'd like the completed workbook and any attestation PDFs by EOD Friday so they can move this into their legal review.

Can you confirm who will own each section? They've attached their intake template (we received it in the vendor portal). If you need a point of contact on our side, reach out to me.

Best,
Alex Reyes
ProcureOps
NovaCloud
Attachment: nova_marketplace_intake_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Alex — thank you. Looping in Laura for billing/metering details and Karthik for security / compliance attachments. Quick plan:

- I will own the marketplace-specific metering mapping and pricing SKU table,
- Laura will fill the metering answers and confirm the usage event pipeline (file-based vs. API),
- Karthik will gather SOC2/ISO evidence and tenant isolation wording (we'll include the HSM/KMS note for Private deployments),
- Marcus will validate metering against our Dedicated and Private SKUs if needed (cc'd).

We should be able to deliver a completed workbook and the evidence bundle (PDFs) by Friday EOD. If procurement needs the answers split by cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) we can tag the worksheet columns accordingly.

Proposed next steps: I will attach a Redwood worksheet that maps our meterable events to Marketplace SKU IDs and a short implementation note. Laura / Karthik will attach evidence PDFs (SOC2 cert, ISO attestation, and sample meter payload spec).

-Ben

Redwood Inference

On Thu, Aug 23, 2028 at 10:04 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Alex — thank you. Looping in Laura for billing/metering details and Karthik for security / compliance attachments. Quick plan:
>
> - I will own the marketplace-specific metering mapping and pricing SKU table,
> - Laura will fill the metering answers and confirm the usage event pipeline (file-based vs. API),

> - Marcus will validate metering against our Dedicated and Private SKUs if needed (cc'd).

Alex / Ben / team — attaching the Redwood metering worksheet (WIP) and a short spec for the usage-event payload we ship to marketplaces. Notes:

- Metering model: per-token billed units with optional reservation credits for Dedicated. We expose a usage API and S3 settlement files (both supported).
- AWS Marketplace expectation: reportable usage via the AWS Marketplace Metering Service (API push) or daily usage files — we support both. See worksheet tab "AWS Mapping" for example event -> SKU mapping.
- Tenant isolation: for Hosted we use tenant-scoped namespaces with logical isolation + envelope encryption; for Private/Dedicated we recommend VPC peering + dedicated pool IDs. Wording included in section 6.
- Billing timing: we provide daily granularity and can batch hourly for high-throughput customers.

Attachments included: redwood_aws_metering_worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet) — WIP, security-evidence-bundle.pdf (zip of certs & attestation). Please treat the evidence bundle as confidential.

Flagging two open questions: (1) Do you need signed attestations on letterhead vs. PDF? (2) For marketplace metering, do you prefer API push or settlement files as default (we can configure per-deal)?

Laura Bennett
Product Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_aws_metering_worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet); security-evidence-bundle.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@awsmarketplace.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-25T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: AWS Marketplace procurement questionnaire — metering & security workbook

Alex — attaching the completed worksheet and evidence bundle per your request. Summary of deliverables: 

1) redwood_aws_metering_worksheet.xlsx — tabs: Overview, AWS Mapping, Azure Mapping, GCP Mapping, Pricing SKU table, Implementation Notes. The AWS Mapping tab shows the SKU we intend to expose and the usage event (tokens_generated, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens) we will report.

2) security-evidence-bundle.pdf — SOC2 Type II report excerpt, ISO27001 attestation, and a short tenancy isolation statement (suitability for Hosted, Dedicated, Private).

Responses to your open questions: (1) We can provide signed letterhead attestations via DocuSign if procurement requires it; (2) For most customers we recommend API push to AWS Metering Service for real-time reconciliation; settlement files are available as fallback for large batch customers.

Next steps: Please confirm receipt and whether NovaCloud procurement wants the evidence delivered into the AWS vendor portal or by email. Happy to jump on a 30-min call Thurs if that helps close legal review.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Director, GTM Engineering
Redwood Inference
